resources.string: The relay keeps up to 24 hours of its logs on this phone. Technical details are kept; passwords, keys, phone numbers, names, messages and precise location are replaced before anything is stored.
Uploads to logs.openxplay.org for the maintainers. Files are kept for up to 30 days and cannot be downloaded publicly. A random ID associates uploads from this app installation.
QR code for the upload receipt
Include this ID or QR code in your bug report. Scanning opens the receipt, without downloading the logs.
Wait at least %1$d seconds before retrying.
No logs were recorded in this period.
The file is larger than 50 MiB. Choose a shorter period or save it.
Unable to read or write the log file.
The upload result could not be confirmed. Keep the file and check the last receipt. Retrying may create another upload.
Upload not confirmed (HTTP %1$d). Keep the file. Retrying may create another upload.
